## Widget showcases

Create a 60–90 second video for one shinywidgets integration. The new workflow covers installation, imports, rendering code, and recorded interaction. Setup and code use readable stills. Widget interactions use continuous browser footage in portrait and landscape.

Both skill archives include a widget starter with source shots and a video-shot fragment. The guide covers library-specific dependencies, readable charcoal code cards, and mouse targets that move after a widget updates.

`prepare_editorial.py` now accepts `views.horizontal.layout: columns` to place code beside an app capture. Panels still stack by default. A browser test checks both layouts.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
